scope: Frozen evaluation of a development-derived threshold hypothesis; never enables a runtime policy
hypothesis_basis: The prior development report proposed 0.175/0.025 after inspecting its 5/80 negative failures. This new cohort must not be used to tune those values.

experiment_gate.interpretation: Bounded synthetic challenge gate only. Bursts and -12 dB cases are stress diagnostics. Passing cannot qualify operational RF specificity or whole-dwell absence.

rf_selection_basis: Four newest complete qualified captures in the read-only metadata inventory at selection time; no IQ or detector/analysis scores inspected. Two preselected sweeps, all eight edges, RX1 only.
rf_unmatched_interpretation: Unresolved RF, not verified no-Starlink truth
